title: Monotonicity of NSPACE under constant rescaling
statement: Let $s_1,s_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and let $a\in\mathbb{N}$. If $s_1(n)\le a s_2(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, then $\mathrm{NSPACE}(s_1)\subseteq\mathrm{NSPACE}(s_2)$.
